name: Explorer Starter Pack
description: The complete Family Quest Center starter experience: everyday explorer quests, family adventures, a choose-your-path exploration book, frames, themes, and the new likeness-based Explorer character set with six skin-tone options for both girl and boy Explorers.

quests.name: Base Camp Cleanup
quests.description: Tidy your room and put your gear, toys, and clothes where they belong.

quests.name: Supply Station
quests.description: Help load or unload the dishwasher and put kitchen supplies away.

quests.name: Laundry Expedition
quests.description: Gather your dirty clothes and place them in the hamper or help put clean clothes away.

quests.name: Trail Sweep
quests.description: Sweep or vacuum an assigned area and leave the trail clear for the family.

quests.name: Camp Table Reset
quests.description: Clear the table after a meal and help return the family base camp to order.

quests.name: Gear Check
quests.description: Pack your backpack, school items, or tomorrow's needed gear so you are ready to explore the day ahead.

adventures.name: Neighborhood Discovery Walk
adventures.description: Take a family-approved walk and see how many interesting things you can discover close to home.

chapters.name: Choose the Route
chapters.description: With a parent, choose a safe route through your neighborhood, park, or nearby trail.

chapters.name: Nature Spotting
chapters.description: Find three different plants, trees, birds, insects, or other signs of nature.

chapters.name: Landmark Hunt
chapters.description: Find one landmark you have passed before but never really stopped to examine.

chapters.name: Explorer Report
chapters.description: Share the most interesting thing you noticed during the walk.

adventures.name: Backyard Field Expedition
adventures.description: Explore your yard, a park, or another parent-approved outdoor space like a field researcher.

chapters.name: Pick a Study Zone
chapters.description: Choose a small safe area to explore closely.

chapters.name: Look High and Low
chapters.description: Search the ground, plants, trees, and sky for interesting details.

chapters.name: Make a Discovery
chapters.description: Choose one rock, leaf, track, bug, cloud, or other natural feature to study without disturbing it.

chapters.name: Record the Find
chapters.description: Draw it, describe it, or tell your family what you discovered.

adventures.name: Indoor Explorer Hunt
adventures.description: Go on an indoor discovery mission and learn something new about your own home.

chapters.name: Choose a Territory
chapters.description: Pick a room, bookshelf, drawer, family photo area, or other parent-approved place to explore.

chapters.name: Find Three Curiosities
chapters.description: Find three objects you have never examined closely before.

chapters.name: Ask the Expert
chapters.description: Ask a family member about one object and learn its story or purpose.

chapters.name: Share the Discovery
chapters.description: Tell the family one new thing you learned about your home.

rewards.name: Explorer Treat
rewards.description: Choose a family-approved treat after earning enough stars.

author: Family Quest Center

books.title: The Mystery of the Hidden Trail
books.description: A strange map sends a young explorer on a choose-your-path journey to discover what waits at the end of a forgotten trail.
